items.title: Graph-based fraud detection with Thoughtworks and Amazon SageMaker
items.summary: Financial institutions lose an estimated $264 billion annually to false declines, while sophisticated fraud networks slip past many traditional AI models. Authorized push payment scam losses are projected to reach $7.6 billion by 2028, with Thoughtworks estimating that cumulative losses could approach $1 trillion by 2035. Learn about a Graph Neural Network reference architecture, developed by Thoughtworks, AWS, and NVIDIA and deployed on Amazon SageMaker with Amazon Neptune, that detects network-level fraud patterns many conventional methods miss, enabling institutions to enhance their existing fraud systems incrementally without a rip-and-replace approach.
items.creator: Shilpa Tyagi
